events_temporal_shape_check.name: events_temporal_shape_check
events_temporal_shape_check.value:
(
    ("events"."all_day" = true and "events"."start_date" is not null and "events"."end_date" is not null
      and "events"."end_date" >= "events"."start_date" and "events"."start_at" is null and "events"."end_at" is null and "events"."time_zone" is null)
    or
    ("events"."all_day" = false and "events"."start_date" is null and "events"."end_date" is null
      and "events"."start_at" is not null and "events"."end_at" is not null and "events"."end_at" > "events"."start_at" and "events"."time_zone" is not null)
  )

places_coordinate_pair_check.name: places_coordinate_pair_check
places_coordinate_pair_check.value:
(
    ("places"."latitude" is null and "places"."longitude" is null)
    or ("places"."latitude" is not null and "places"."longitude" is not null
      and "places"."latitude" >= -90 and "places"."latitude" <= 90
      and "places"."longitude" >= -180 and "places"."longitude" <= 180)
  )

reviews_completion_shape_check.name: reviews_completion_shape_check
reviews_completion_shape_check.value: ("reviews"."status" = 'draft' and "reviews"."completed_at" is null) or ("reviews"."status" = 'completed' and "reviews"."completed_at" is not null)
